steps.text: Turmeric paper is yellow. Let's find out which substances it can detect.
Test a base — tap “Soap” (or baking soda).
The yellow turmeric turns RED/BROWN. Turmeric changes colour only for BASES.
It stays YELLOW. Turmeric can't tell acids from neutral substances — both stay yellow.
So turmeric is a partial indicator: it only detects bases. (That's why a curry stain turns red when soap touches it!)
